mentions.name: Structured OCR resume tools
mentions.description: Structured OCR tools that read resume PDFs and enable much more useful search filters over them than the existing ATS system allows, using Gemini with structured outputs to perform the extraction.
mentions.problem: Existing ATS systems do not allow useful search filters over resume PDFs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on some structured OCR tools recently (in the context of reading resume pdfs and allowing much more useful search filters over them than our ATS system allows) and I've found Gemini with structured outputs capable of doing a fantastic job.

evidence.value: I've been working on some structured OCR tools recently (in the context of reading resume pdfs and allowing much more useful search filters over them than our ATS system allows) and I've found Gemini with structured outputs capable of doing a fantastic job.
